mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_plan_meal (id, plan_id, day_index, meal_index, dish_id, swap_count, checked, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{planId}, #{dayIndex}, #{mealIndex}, #{dishId}, #{swapCount}, #{checked}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, day_index, meal_index, dish_id, swap_count, checked, checked_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM user_plan_meal WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT m.id, m.plan_id, m.day_index, m.meal_index, m.dish_id, m.swap_count, m.checked, m.checked_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.deleted, d.dish_name, d.dish_image, d.calories, d.protein, d.fat, d.carbs, d.tags FROM user_plan_meal m LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = m.dish_id WHERE m.plan_id = #{planId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.day_index ASC, m.meal_index ASC
mapper.update:

dish_id = #{dishId}, swap_count = #{swapCount}, checked = #{checked}, checked_time = #{checkedTime}, checked_time = NULL, update_time = NOW()
